name: histogram
summary: How values spread: touching columns counting each bin over a value axis. Send each value and Tiles bins them, or send bin starts in x with counts in y; a threshold draws a dashed rule and colours the bins from it on. Takes an axis title.

roles.name: x
roles.doc: each value, such as minutes to first touch, or each bin's start when y gives the counts

roles.name: y
roles.doc: the count in each bin, with x as the bin's start and the starts an equal step apart; leave it out and Tiles counts the values into bins

roles.name: threshold
roles.doc: a limit the title names, such as an SLA of 15; the first row's number is used, and the bins from it on take the accent
